purpose: Bind the current SLIP long-horizon corpus to the manual readability protocol, produce the reviewer template, and only unlock calibration after real reviewer rows satisfy completeness, reliability, and proxy-correlation checks.

external_anchors.source: Comparing PCG metrics with Human Evaluation in Minecraft Settlement Generation
external_anchors.used_for: Proxy readability metrics are treated as hypotheses that must be compared against human ratings before threshold claims.

external_anchors.source: A comprehensive guide to study the agreement and reliability of multi-observer ordinal data
external_anchors.used_for: Stage 0 records reviewer count and agreement checks separately from proxy-human correlation.

questions.silhouette: Can the creature body be recognized from its outline alone?
questions.organ_clarity: Are sensors, expression cells, and body core easy to identify?
questions.palette_contrast: Does the palette separate body, organs, and background?
questions.animation_readiness: Is there a clear anchor or pose feature for simple motion?
questions.companion_appeal: Does the grid read as a plausible companion rather than noise?

instructions: Rate each sample independently before seeing generator source.
Use 1 for unreadable/noisy, 3 for usable but ambiguous, and 5 for immediately legible.
Do not treat novelty as readability unless the creature remains recognizable.
Record reviewer id, timestamp, and optional notes separately from proxy metrics.

source_refs.name: Comparing PCG metrics with Human Evaluation in Minecraft Settlement Generation
source_refs.use: Reference for comparing procedural-content metrics against human evaluation.

source_refs.name: Measuring inter-rater reliability for nominal data
source_refs.use: Reference for treating reviewer agreement as a required reliability concern.

decision.reason: The intake protocol and CSV template exist, but no reviewer ratings were supplied. Proxy calibration remains blocked.

limitations: No human ratings are bundled unless a reviewer CSV is supplied.
Spearman correlation is unstable for very small or tied rating sets.
Reviewer reliability is approximated with mean absolute deltas in Stage 0.
Formal inter-rater reliability should be added after real rating volume exists.

next_research_step: Collect 63 reviewer rows in data/readability/slip_readability_calibration_ratings.csv and rerun this gate before changing proxy readability thresholds or claiming profile-weighted evolution.
limitations: No human ratings are fabricated by this lab.
A complete template alone does not calibrate the proxy metric.
Spearman correlation remains descriptive at Stage 0 and must not be treated as a causal readability model.
Profile-weighted evolution still also requires package/runtime integration.
